one_liner: Training Data For Speech Models.
desc: We design and collect audio datasets for training speech models.

name: Frontrunner
one_liner: Cursor for GTM
desc:
Build agents that research accounts, find prospects, run campaigns, update your CRM, qualify inbound, and more. Connect them to the systems you already use and let them work alongside your GTM team.

Engineer your revenue factory on Frontrunner.

name: The Subvocal Company
one_liner: Talk to your computer without talking
desc: We're building a silent speech wearable that lets you talk to your computer at the speed of voice, but silently and completely imperceptibly to everyone around you.

name: Quippy
one_liner: Helps build social skills through daily practice
desc: Quippy is a daily practice app for your social life. You run short, realistic practice conversations, like pushing back on a boss or talking during a first date, and get line-by-line feedback on what landed and what backfired. The curriculum adapts to each person's patterns, reshaping itself around their weak spots, ensuring steady improvement in the conversations that matter most.

name: Sona8
one_liner: Voice agents that talk to employees enabling transformations
desc:
Sona8 is a voice agent that talks to every employee in a company about how their work gets done.

Each employee gets a link and talks to the agent for about 20 minutes. The agent asks follow-up questions, for example why a step is still done by hand or who else is involved. From the conversations we build process maps and a list of the problems
people described, sorted by site and team.

name: Sinter
one_liner: Accelerating scaled plastics with additive technologies
desc: Sinter is creating a faster and radically more affordable American plastics pipeline, helping iteration heavy hardware teams evolve from additive prototypes to production parts on week-scale timelines.

name: antimattr
one_liner: voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction
desc:
antimattr builds a voice-first hardware interface for human-agent interaction that includes a ring and a pair of earphones. Designed to make more of your voice, the ring can record and summarise your conversations, capture thoughts on the go, or control your agents. The earphones use proprietary voice isolation technology to block out background noise entirely, so you can take a clear call from a loud pub or dictate with real accuracy.

Reserve early access at https://www.antimattr.one/project-mnemosyne
[use code YC at checkout]

name: Hesper AI
one_liner: AI Claims Investigator for Insurance
desc:
Hesper AI builds AI agents that investigate P&C insurance claims end to end.

Hesper’s agents read the claim file, detect tampered documents, verify facts, check coverage, flag inconsistencies, and produce an audit-ready case file in minutes, so insurers can check every claim. 

We work with Claims and SIU orgs at Carriers, MGAs and TPAs,

name: Covera
one_liner: AI-native OS for insurance brokers
desc: Covera builds AI agents for insurance brokers. Our ready-to-use agents take over the day-to-day servicing work: submission intake, carrier quoting, quote comparison, claims handling, past-due collections, and account rounding. That means brokers can spend their time advising and selling clients instead of doing data entry. We work with agencies of every size and connect natively to the tools they already use.

name: Halmos Labs
one_liner: Maximum information per experiment, minimum experiments per conclusion
desc: Halmos Labs builds automated biotech R&D on the principles of validity and interpretabillity. We run research, and simulations answering open questions ranging from wetlab experiment design to full cancer vaccine manufacturing.

name: Dreamscale Labs
one_liner: Running robot brains in the cloud
desc: Dreamscale Labs is building the fastest cloud inference platform for robotics. As complex physical AI models become difficult to fit on expensive on-robot GPUs, we let users offload inference to the cloud and serve them with real-time latency. So far, we've hit 40-50% lower latency than existing neoclouds.

name: Vorelios
one_liner: AI that simulates physics 1000x faster
desc: Engineering is bottlenecked by slow, costly simulations. We're fixing that by building foundation models that learn physics end-to-end and deliver the same results in seconds, at a fraction of the cost.

name: SuperRadiant
one_liner: Embodied Scientific Intelligence
desc: Every instance of intelligence occurring in nature is embodied. Scientific intelligence is no different. We are building general-purpose robotic experimentalists: systems that unite scientific reasoning and physical action to iterate toward discovery by observing, hypothesizing and experimenting.

name: Orca Aerospace
one_liner: AI spacecraft operators that lives onboard the vehicle
desc: At Orca, we are focused on creating the future of spacecraft operations by moving control onto the vehicle. By allowing LLMs to control the satellite using deterministic tooling, we are able to achieve the same holistic, high-quality decisions on "what" to do to carry out a mission while maintaining the safety of systems that decide "how" to execute it.

name: Hemlock
one_liner: Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI
desc:
Every serious robotics lab is bottlenecked on the same thing: demonstration data. The field has converged on egocentric video and hand pose as the substrate, and both are now cheap to collect at scale. What neither of them contains is force. A video of someone picking up an egg and a video of someone picking up a rock are nearly identical in pixel space and nearly identical in joint angles. They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch.

Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our device, the Bracelet, i

name: ORO AI
one_liner: Continuously improving evals for agentic commerce
desc:
We're building the open benchmark for commerce.

Builders submit shopping agents. Independent validators run them against problems that change daily. The best agent earns the rewards, and every run becomes training data.

name: Shepherd Robotics
one_liner: Robots for high skilled labor powering AI infrastructure
desc:
Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks.
We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows. We are starting with tasks such as data center construction and operations, cable and wire manufacturing, wire harness assembly, kitting, and factory packaging, where traditional au

name: Workers IO
one_liner: Simulation Environments for Verifying Mission Critical Software
desc:
Workers IO verifies your entire system across millions of interleaving, faults, and timings to find the exact conditions that break the software properties you care about.

Built for teams where 99.99% uptime is table-stakes.

name: Antropi Robotics
one_liner: Autonomous CNC factories for faster hardware

name: ByteAsk
one_liner: The AI coding agent for C and C++
desc: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for C and C++, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and operating systems. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem.

name: Hopper
one_liner: Fast inference for voice
desc: Our customers use Hopper today for two things: replacing GPT-4.1 with Gemma-4 (6x faster), and replacing Elevenlabs with qwen3-tts (8x cheaper).

name: Asakana
one_liner: AI order entry for food distributors: emails and texts to ERP
desc: Restaurants send orders to food distributors by email, text, and photo. Someone at the distributor retypes every one of them into the ERP. Asakana does that entry instead: orders land in the ERP already entered, and anything unclear goes to a person before it goes in. Live at US seafood distributors today, returning 40%+ of order-desk time to selling. Founded by a seafood distributor and a Gemini builder.

name: OnePatch
one_liner: Automate on-call at agent-scale.
desc: OnePatch is a forward-deployed AI SRE. It instruments your services, watches how they actually behave in prod, catches incidents, and drives each one to resolution. Think Datadog, except it doesn't stop at telling you something broke: it keeps going until the fix is shipped.

name: Mirrors
one_liner: Catch and fix AI agent regressions before they reach production
desc:
Mirrors provides regression testing for AI agents.

Teams shipping agents constantly change prompts, models, and tools, and there's no way to test any of it. Agents call bespoke internal tools and APIs no test framework can reproduce, so most teams ship on vibes.

Mirrors rebuilds the tools your agent calls from your own production traces, then replays real sessions against every change before it merges. You see which tool calls changed, which arguments moved, and where state landed differently. And when something fails, we tell you whether your agent regressed or something upstream moved.

name: Nodus Compute
one_liner: Intelligent execution layer for AI workloads
desc: Intelligent execution layer for AI workloads

name: Lantern AI
one_liner: Turn Your Taste Into Hires
desc: Lantern learns what exceptional looks like for your team, pressure-tests the role against the real talent market, then runs the hiring loop: sourcing, inbound applications, interviews, assessments, candidate communication, and offers.

name: Talos
one_liner: Predictive maintenance for power infrastructure.
desc: At Talos, we are building better, more modern predictive maintenance for the power industry with a focus on large transformers. Our devices continuously monitor critical power equipment and detect problems early on using anomaly-detection models. For each fault, we provide detailed analyses of the problem, exactly where and why it happened, as well as next steps teams should take.

name: Forward
one_liner: Unifying Global Private Credit
desc: An AI platform that connects commercial debt advisors with mandate matching private credit funds.

name: Capveon
one_liner: Turning infrastructure demand into action

name: Ascii

desc:

Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities. 

Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial.

**Solution**

Box provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a box, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing.

**Why Box and not any other cloud VM?**

1. It is ready out of the box: every box ships with a desktop, chrome, languages, docker

name: Qokedas

name: Veeza AI

name: Sentient OS
one_liner: On-device AI that knows your entire life and does your work overnight.
desc:
Nobody's built truly proactive AI, because it requires running inference on your entire life. In the cloud, that's insanely expensive and a privacy nightmare. But not on your own chip.

Every night, Sentient's on-device LLM wakes your Mac and understands what's new in your life (email, messages, files, Granola transcripts...), entirely locally, and distills it into a knowledge base.

You wake up to your work already prepared: the reply you forgot, drafted from your own context; the subscription you never use renewing tomorrow, caught; the report you promised in the group chat, ready to sen

name: herdr
one_liner: building the open agent runtime
desc:
Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed.

Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH. Herdr detects each agent and turns the chaos into an attention queue — working, blocked, done, across eve

name: Lambda Robotics
one_liner: Robotics for AI Infrastructure
desc: Lambda Robotics builds and deploys robots for the infrastructure powering frontier AI.

name: Simantic
one_liner: Firmware simulation for AI agents
desc: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.

name: Lightfield

desc: Lightfield connects to a company’s email, chat, and business systems and does the legal work before it reaches the legal team. It gathers context, applies company policies and past decisions, and presents the completed work to in-house counsel for approval.

RightNow AI lab: https://rightnowai.co
RunInfra platform: https://runinfra.ai.

CFOs and IR heads can actually focus on building relationships and getting their company’s story heard.
